rec.name: Homepage Shoppable Lifestyle Image with Dynamic Product Spotlight
rec.status: Reference only (design mockup, build status unknown)

what.text: A homepage 'Spotlight' section with two parts. On the left is a large lifestyle photo (a desk setup) with clickable hotspot dots on individual products. On the right is a product spotlight card showing the product image, star rating with review count (e.g. 760 reviews), product title, a 'from' price, and color/material swatches. Clicking a hotspot on the image changes the product shown in the spotlight card on the right. Prev/next arrow buttons below the card let users browse through the spotlight products.

why.text: A shoppable lifestyle image shows products in context, so visitors can picture them in their own space and discover items by exploring instead of searching. Each hotspot gives a low-effort, curiosity-driven path to a product. The spotlight card puts rating, price and variants in one place, which adds social proof and reduces clicks before the PDP. Arrows keep users browsing and increase product exposure. This works especially well for paid traffic landing on the homepage.

how.text: Build a custom section with an image block that has hotspot blocks. Each hotspot stores X/Y position (% of the image) and a linked product. The right-hand spotlight card renders the product's featured image, review rating and count (from the reviews app), title, 'from' price, and color swatches. JS listens for hotspot clicks and swaps the card content, either by pre-rendering all product cards and toggling visibility or by fetching product data. The active hotspot gets a highlighted ring. Prev/next arrows cycle through the hotspot products in order and sync the active hotspot. The card links to the PDP.

items: Hotspot blocks: product picker plus X/Y position

dependencies.text: A reviews app providing rating and count (e.g. Judge.me, Loox, Yotpo) exposed to Liquid or metafields. Products need variant/color options with swatch mapping. Custom Liquid and JS are needed for hotspot logic. No metafields are confirmed in the source.

items: Revenue per session for homepage landers

images.caption: Mockup: lifestyle desk photo with hotspot dots on the left; a callout notes that clicking a hotspot changes the product in the right-hand spotlight. Right: product card with rating, title, 'from' price, color swatches and prev/next arrows.
